title: Perceived Effectiveness of Social Debt Mitigation Measures: A Preliminary Vignette-Based Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.23263v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software engineering is a socio-technical discipline in which unresolved social and organizational problems accumulate as social debt, gradually eroding collaboration and project health. The literature offers a solid vocabulary for these problems but says little about which countermeasures practitioners consider effective. We address this gap with a vignette-based survey: six social debt problem dimensions (Organizational Silo, Newcomer Isolation, Communication Breakdown, Knowledge Bottleneck, Cultural and Geographical Distance, Psychological Safety Deficit) were presented as realistic team scenarios, and 23 IT professionals and advanced students rated 41 literature-derived mitigation measures. Rankings were analyzed with paired t-tests and a hierarchical Bayesian model that accounts for the within-subject design and yields, for each measure, the probability of being the best option in its scenario. translated_title: 社会债务缓解措施的感知有效性：一项初步的情景式问卷调查
translated_abstract: 软件工程是一门社会技术学科，未解决的社会性与组织性问题会不断累积为“社会债务”，逐渐侵蚀团队协作与项目健康。现有文献为这类问题提供了扎实的术语体系，却很少说明从业者认为哪些应对措施是有效的。我们通过一项基于情景的问卷调查来填补这一空白：将六种社会债务问题维度（组织孤岛、新人孤立、沟通中断、知识瓶颈、文化与地理距离、心理安全感缺失）呈现为贴近现实的团队场景，由23名IT从业者与高年级学生对41项源自文献的缓解措施进行评分。评分排名通过配对t检验和一个考虑被试内设计的分层贝叶斯模型进行分析，该模型为每项措施给出其在其场景中成为最佳选项的概率。仅在沟通中断场景中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过情景式问卷调查，让23名IT从业者和高年级学生对六类社会债务问题场景中的41项缓解措施进行有效性评分，并用配对t检验与分层贝叶斯模型分析排名，初步揭示了从业者眼中针对不同社会债务问题最有效的应对措施。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a preliminary vignette-based survey in which 23 IT professionals and advanced students rated 41 literature-derived mitigation measures across six social debt problem dimensions, with rankings analyzed via paired t-tests and a hierarchical Bayesian model to identify which countermeasures practitioners perceive as most effective.
